physics-killer-05.topic: Is dhaca iyo badbaado, mashruuc toosan iyo cufis-jiidasho
physics-killer-05.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-05.material: Shay cufnaantiisu tahay $2\\,\\mathrm{kg}$ ayaa ku socda jihada $+x$ $4\\,\\mathrm{m/s}$. Xoog jihada $+x$ ah ayaa ku shaqeeya shayga, cabbirka xooggana wuxuu si joogto ah uga kordhaa $0\\sim0.1\\,\\mathrm{s}$ ilaa $0$ intii u dhaxaysay $40\\,\\mathrm{N}$, wuxuu joogto ku yahay $0.1\\sim0.3\\,\\mathrm{s}$ intii u dhaxaysay $40\\,\\mathrm{N}$, wuxuuna si joogto ah uga yaraadaa $0.3\\sim0.4\\,\\mathrm{s}$ ilaa $40\\,\\mathrm{N}$ intii u dhaxaysay $0$. Intii lagu jiray $0.4\\,\\mathrm{s}$ ee xooggan uu ku shaqeeyay, cabbirka impulse-ka shaygu helay iyo xawaaraha shayga isla markiiba ka dib marka xooggu libdhay, si kala horreeya, kuwee ayaa si sax ah isugu xidhan? (Xoog kale ma jiro.)

physics-killer-05.s.s1.prompt: Shay cufnaantiisu tahay $2\\,\\mathrm{kg}$ ayaa ku socda jihada $+x$ $4\\,\\mathrm{m/s}$. Xoog jihada $+x$ ah ayaa ku shaqeeya shayga, cabbirka xooggana wuxuu si joogto ah uga kordhaa $0\\sim0.1\\,\\mathrm{s}$ ilaa $0$ intii u dhaxaysay $40\\,\\mathrm{N}$, wuxuu joogto ku yahay $0.1\\sim0.3\\,\\mathrm{s}$ intii u dhaxaysay $40\\,\\mathrm{N}$, wuxuuna si joogto ah uga yaraadaa $0.3\\sim0.4\\,\\mathrm{s}$ ilaa $40\\,\\mathrm{N}$ intii u dhaxaysay $0$. Intii lagu jiray $0.4\\,\\mathrm{s}$ ee xooggan uu ku shaqeeyay, cabbirka impulse-ka shaygu helay iyo xawaaraha shayga isla markiiba ka dib marka xooggu libdhay, si kala horreeya, kuwee ayaa si sax ah isugu xidhan? (Xoog kale ma jiro.)
physics-killer-05.s.s1.explain: Aagagga: saddex-xagalka koowaad $\frac12\cdot0.1\cdot40=2$, afar-xagal $0.2\cdot40=8$, saddex-xagalka u dambeeya $2$, sidaas darteed $I=12\,\mathrm{N\cdot s}$. Laga bilaabo $I=m(v-v_0)$, $12=2(v-4)\Rightarrow v=10\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Haddii garaafka oo dhan loo qaato afar-xagal $40\cdot0.4=16$ waxay bixisaa doodda 2; iyadoo saddex-xagalladii laga tago oo $8$ la isticmaalo waxay bixisaa doodda 3; iyadoo $I$ aan loo qaybin cufnaanta oo la qoro $4+12=16$ waxay bixisaa doodda 4.
physics-killer-05.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-05.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
